stage: data and public-resource audit only; model execution protocol follows before training
registered_before: cohort construction and any v27 prediction
task: Retrospective prediction of mapped medication classes for an entire hospital visit, given that visit's recorded diagnosis/procedure codes and completed prior visits. This task does not establish admission-time information availability.
source: User-licensed local MIMIC-IV 3.1; adult hospital admissions with an ICU stay
visits: Keep visits with at least one diagnosis, one procedure and one unambiguously NDC-mapped ATC-L4 medication. Keep patients with at least two eligible visits; sort by admission time then admission ID. Retain all eligible visits. Current medication labels never enter the current input.
mapping: Existing pinned SafeDrug/GAMENet NDC-RXCUI-ATC4 public table; exact normalized 11-digit NDC only; exclude ambiguous NDC assignments; retain true five-character ATC-L4. No learned name/GSN fallback in this panel. Report unmapped source rows and label/OOV coverage.
split: Reuse patient-split-2026 BLAKE2b 80/10/10 assignment; divide validation patients by a separate v27 hash into proposal and guard. Sample by fixed patient hash, independent of labels and scores.
test_status: The source population overlaps earlier research. Quantify overlap with existing local evaluation cohorts. Treat results as exploratory, not a fresh untouched confirmation set.
vocabulary: Fit diagnosis/procedure/medication vocabularies on training patients only; unseen inputs use explicit unknown indexes and unseen medications remain in recall denominators. Do not drop test labels to fit a training vocabulary.
public_molecules: Use pinned drug-atc.csv CID to full ATC mapping, aggregate by five-character prefix, obtain public CID ConnectivitySMILES from PubChem PUG REST, validate with RDKit, and retain every valid mapped molecule. These class molecular sets are research resources, not ingredient-level equivalence or clinical DDI rules.
ddi: Pinned author-linked TWOSIDES pair source; class graph scope and molecule/class coverage reported. EHR co-occurrence graph uses training visits only. No absent molecule or graph is silently replaced with zeros and called a faithful method.
candidate_methods: RxRSIAgent structured prescription tool with matched update controls
claim_boundary: This is a separate historical visit-set panel. It cannot be pooled with six-hour new-order, full-order-tuple, QA, or FHIR execution scores. Original paper scores remain in separate reported-result panels. No model result exists yet.
privacy: All patient records, sequences, predictions and fitted artifacts remain under dataset/restricted. Public downloads contain only external drug identifiers/molecular metadata, never patient inputs.
